classification.habitat: Cultivated fields and dry to semi-arid areas
classification.distribution: Widely cultivated in India and other tropical regions

identification.description: Small leguminous herb with trifoliate leaves, papilionaceous flowers and slender pods containing hard seeds.
identification.whole_plant: Herbaceous, branched annual; generally low-growing to semi-erect.
identification.root: Taproot with lateral roots; leguminous root system.
identification.stem: Slender, branched and herbaceous, becoming firmer toward maturity.
identification.leaf: Trifoliate leaves with ovate to lanceolate leaflets and a distinct petiole.
identification.flower: Small papilionaceous flowers, usually pale yellow to yellowish.
identification.fruit: Slender, curved to slightly straight pod containing several seeds.
identification.seed: Small, hard, kidney-shaped or angular seeds, commonly reddish-brown to mottled depending on variety.
identification.bark: Not applicable as a herbaceous annual.

therapeutics.precautions: Use should be individualized; avoid presenting traditional indications as established treatment claims.

modern_information.evidence_summary: Horse gram is a food legume studied for nutritional and metabolic properties; this record does not infer clinical efficacy.
modern_information.safety_notes: Food and medicinal use should be distinguished; clinical claims require appropriate evidence.
